answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 8672 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to recite Qur'an Sharif while leaning against the headboard of one's bed? Question: Is it permissible to recite Qur'an Sharif while leaning against the headboard of one's bed? Answer ID: 8672 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2304/1894=B/1429) If there is any problem, there is no wrong in reciting the Quran while leaning against headboard: وقال الحافظ ابن کثیر: اي لایکلف أحدا فوق طاقتہ و ھذا من لطفہ تعالی بخلقہ و رأفتہ بھم وإحسانہ إلیھم ( تفسیر ابن کثیر 1:457 ) But, if one does it without any problem and excuse, then it is against the etiquettes and curtsey: ولا تقعدوا علی مکان أرفع مما علیہ القرآن (حیوۃ المسلمین 54) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
